title: 6 Things a Godly Man Does Before He Ever Prays for a Wife
caption:
6 things a godly man does before he ever prays for a wife. None of them mention her.

He learns to be alone with God before he's alone with anyone else. He kills the sin he'd be ashamed to bring into a marriage. He builds a life that doesn't need rescuing.

He tells the truth to a brother before he tells it to a girlfriend. He wants God's will more than he wants her yes.

Build the man first. The marriage inherits whoever shows up.

#godlymen #christianmen #biblicalmanhood #futurewife #discipleship
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
